System.assert(u1.isSuccess()); Account a2 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Id Access'); insert a2; Database.DeleteResult d2 = Database.delete(a2.Id, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(d2.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult u2 = Database.undelete(a2.Id, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(u2.isSuccess()); Account a3 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Id Boolean'); insert a3; Database.DeleteResult d3 = Database.delete(a3.Id, false); insert new List<Account>{a5, a6}; List<Id> ids1 = new List<Id>{a5.Id, a6.Id}; List<Database.DeleteResult> d5 = Database.delete(ids1); System.assertEquals(2, d5.size()); System.assert(d5[0].isSuccess());
